# Joseph and Aseneth Chapter 8 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 8:2 — vainglorious vs. conceited

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "vainglorious and praised myself" | Literal kenodoxos |
| LOGOS | "conceited, boasting before all men" | Modern equivalent |
| PNEUMA | "full of myself" | Colloquial |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** LOGOS 'conceited' is precise and formal. 'Vainglorious' (EMET) is accurate but archaic. 'Full of myself' (PNEUMA) is too casual. Adopted LOGOS.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 8:10 — old and ugly and dead gods

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "old and ugly and dead gods — of wood and stone" | Literal with dash |
| LOGOS | "old and ugly and dead — gods of wood and stone" | Restructured |
| PNEUMA | "ancient, grotesque, and dead — just wood and stone" | Paraphrase |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** LOGOS restructuring clarifies the Greek syntax without loss. PNEUMA's 'grotesque' is interpretive; 'ugly' follows aischroi. Adopted LOGOS.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---
